items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Dick by the interviewee (Alice Zeno). The mention is solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Oh, you're not taking a picture of me, I hope. No, no. No, no.

It's going to get out of the way, huh? Yeah, I think it was a deep bit. When Dick was patting you, he was one of those smart people, you see. He's one of those smart people that he's lying, I had to pat him on the back.
That's when we get out of the way. How many different languages could you read? Did you read German to you?
